name: ai-coding-project-forge
description: Bilingual EW AI Coding application forge for non-programmers, from ideas and workflows to verifiable Codex-ready engineering tasks, testing, acceptance, and optional Local Engineering.

interface.shortDescription: Idea to app｜從想法到應用
interface.longDescription: EW AI Coding helps people turn ideas, SOPs, workflows, repetitive tasks, and existing software projects into verifiable AI Coding work. v0.9.3 adds existing-project takeover, evidence-based Codex task cards, Build-Test-Fix-Acceptance gates, failure classification, release authorization, and an on-demand Local Engineering route. EW AI Coding 幫助使用者把想法、SOP、流程、重複工作與既有軟體專案轉成可驗證的 AI Coding 工程任務；v0.9.3 新增既有專案接手、證據導向任務卡、開發測試修正驗收閘門、失敗分類、發布授權，以及按需啟動的本機／邊緣工程路徑。
